svg.title: One shelf, three different readings
svg.desc: The original dense shelf, a provisional 42-group numbered overlay, and the Agent result demonstrate that visible units and front facings produce different totals.
svg.text: The counting contract changes what a correct answer means
The numbered overlay is not human-approved ground truth.
It remains a useful provisional reference.
Different counting questions produce different totals.
Human verification and one agreed contract must precede accuracy scoring.
